_notes: Cities sourced from trucksimulator.wiki.gg — all entries verified against the wiki city list.
Cities are ordered: base game first (CA, NV), then free DLC (AZ), then paid DLC in release order.
Within each state cities are alphabetical; this order defines sequential location/item IDs.
has_garage: player can purchase and upgrade a garage in this city.
recruitment_office_count: number of driver recruitment offices discoverable in this city.
Texarkana appears in both Texas (texarkana_tx) and Arkansas (texarkana_ar) as separate city IDs.
Kansas City appears in both Kansas (kansas_city_ks) and Missouri (kansas_city_mo).
Longview appears in both Texas (longview_tx) and Washington (longview_wa).
Burlington appears in both Colorado (burlington_co) and Iowa (burlington_ia).
Salina appears in both Kansas (salina_ks) and Utah (salina_ut).
Sidney appears in both Montana (sidney_mt) and Nebraska (sidney_ne).
